answer: Deposits are visible in mirror, and lotus reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 137 aliases, and each one needs its own funded onyx account. A bond of 39% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 136 aliases cost 169 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
